# omadafusion_lan_network (Data Source)

Looks up a LAN network by name. The default network matches both its plain name and the `Name(Default)` form.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_lan_network" "staff" {
  name = "Staff"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name.

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`.

### Read-Only

- `dhcp_dns_mode` (String) `auto` (gateway) or `manual`.
- `dhcp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway serves DHCP on this network.
- `dhcp_end` (String) Last address in the DHCP pool.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First address in the DHCP pool.
- `gateway_subnet` (String) Gateway address with prefix, e.g. `192.168.10.1/24`.
- `id` (String) Network ID.
- `isolation` (Boolean) Whether client isolation is on.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID.
